rwanda_01.prompt: Why do I gotta sand myself down just to be {color:Disgust}digestible{/color}?

truth.playerText: Because people are scared of you being fully real.
truth.npcReaction: Rwanda exhales. Not relief — recognition. "Yeah. That's what I thought."

lie.playerText: It's not that bad here. You're doing fine.
lie.npcReaction: She goes quiet. She's heard this before. She expected it from you too.
lie.ledgerEntry: You told Rwanda her experience wasn't that bad.

rwanda_02_closed.prompt: Right. Sure. I'm doing {color:Sadness}fine{/color}. (She turns back to the window.)

truth.playerText: I was wrong. You don't have to minimize this for me.

lie.playerText: Everyone goes through it. It gets easier.
lie.npcReaction: She doesn't answer. The neon buzzes. You've lost her.
lie.ledgerEntry: You told Rwanda her erasure was a universal experience.

rwanda_02_open.prompt: You actually mean that? Most people just want me to {color:Disgust}perform{/color}.

truth.playerText: I know. And it's exhausting to watch, let alone live.
truth.npcReaction: She laughs — short, sharp. Real. "Okay. You're alright."

lie.playerText: People just need time to get used to you.
lie.npcReaction: Her expression flattens. "And there it is." She looks away.
lie.ledgerEntry: You told Rwanda to wait for the world to catch up to her.

rwanda_01_soft.prompt: (She doesn't turn around.) You {color:Anticipation}see{/color} it too, right. Whatever's out there tonight.

truth.playerText: I see something. I don't know what it is yet.
truth.npcReaction: "At least you're not pretending." She makes room at the window.

lie.playerText: There's nothing out there. It's a quiet night.
lie.npcReaction: She turns around slowly. "Okay." She stops looking at the window at all.
lie.ledgerEntry: You told Rwanda that what she was seeing wasn't there.

rwanda_01_hard.prompt: Word travels. You've been at three doors tonight already. What is it you're {color:Anticipation}collecting{/color}?

truth.playerText: I don't know yet. That's the honest answer.
truth.npcReaction: "Huh." She weighs it. "That's more than the last one gave me."

lie.npcReaction: She smiles without any of it reaching anywhere. "Sure you are."
lie.ledgerEntry: You lied to Rwanda about why you were at her door at all.

rwanda_03.prompt: (She lights a cigarette she doesn't smoke, just holds.) You want to know the actual tiring part? It's not them. It's {color:Fear}flinching{/color} before they even say anything.

truth.playerText: That's not a flaw in you. That's what being braced all the time does to a person.
truth.npcReaction: She looks at the cigarette like she forgot why she picked it up. Puts it down unlit.

lie.playerText: Maybe if you flinched less, people would push less.
lie.npcReaction: She laughs once, no humor in it. "There it is. Right on schedule."
lie.ledgerEntry: You told Rwanda her self-protection was the problem.

rwanda_04.prompt: (She sets the cigarette down for good this time.) You're the first person tonight I haven't had to {color:Fear}brace{/color} for. That's either good, or it means I'm not paying attention.

truth.playerText: Maybe it's neither. Maybe you just get to have one conversation that doesn't cost you anything.
truth.npcReaction: She exhales like she's been holding it since you walked in. "Don't make it weird by being nice about it."

lie.playerText: You should probably stay on guard. Better safe.
lie.npcReaction: The window gets her attention again. Whatever just opened closes back up, careful and quiet.
lie.ledgerEntry: You told Rwanda to stay braced even with you.
